description: This file defines the AdamW optimizer class for PyTorch, including its initialization, documentation, and a functional API implementation. It imports dependencies, defines the AdamW class inheriting from Adam, and provides a function for the AdamW algorithm.

classes.name: AdamW
classes.description: A class implementing the AdamW optimizer, which decouples weight decay from the gradient-based update.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AdamW optimizer with parameters such as learning rate, betas, epsilon, weight decay, and other options.

methods.name: __setstate__
methods.description: Ensures that the 'decoupled_weight_decay' attribute is set to True when loading the optimizer state.

methods.name: adamw
methods.description: Functional API that performs the AdamW algorithm computation, calling the external 'adam' function with decoupled weight decay.
